note: Readings of the provider-spend ledgers, each taken by hand and recorded here with where it came from. This file plus the round provenance in eval/results/ is the only source of a money figure in this repository; docs/spend-ledger.md is generated from it by `python -m eval.spend_ledger`. Nothing else states a total.

readings.read_from: provider_spend on the scored service's volume, read over ssh from the host filesystem (the service is loopback-bound and publishes no domain), after round r4 — the final round
provider_spend on the app service's volume, same method

provider_spend on https://wf-agent.zeabur.app/healthz, after the r5 dev round. Read from the public endpoint rather than off the volume: the app publishes its own ledger, and the earlier readings needed ssh only because the scored service does not

unledgered: Local development ran on the free tier against ephemeral stores (`tiers_usable_under_policy: ["free"]` in every dev-local provenance block), so those calls were never charged and no surviving ledger totals them. They are absent from the notional figure, which is therefore a floor rather than a total.

The public app's per-day rows we hold sum to 0.134762 notional against a published cumulative of 0.135131 — a gap of 0.000369 on a day nobody took a reading for. It is notional, so nothing was charged either way; it is recorded rather than rounded away because a total that does not reconcile with its own rows is a total nobody can check.
